o.text: From itmək (“to be lost, to vanish”) + -ir (causative suffix).
From Persian خستهخانه (xaste-xâne). By surface analysis, xəstə (“sick”) + -xana.

Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish دَكَمَكْ (däŋämäk, “to compare, measure; to try”), from Proto-Turkic *teŋe- (“to value, compare”), a derivation from Proto-Turkic *teŋ (“equal”). Cognate with Turkish denemek.
